claims.summary: Documented best-effort timing behavior: command/metadata/clock/helper failures warn and continue with original workflow assignment, result, routing, and gates; begin failure creates no later record; finish reads the ending clock before publication; documented bounded warnings and no retry/traceback forwarding.

Added pure consolidation over one already-read snapshot. Records group by opaque invocation_id and the normalized fourteen-field projection; identical copies collapse, any distinct projection excludes the whole identity group, and candidate/accepted/duplicate/conflict/skipped/invalid counts are checked for conservation.

behavior_checks.name: normalized-projection-deduplication
behavior_checks.detail: Absent model/effort and explicit null normalize equally; unknown JSON fields are excluded from the canonical fourteen-field projection.

behavior_checks.name: whole-conflict-group-exclusion
behavior_checks.detail: A conflicting identity containing two identical copies plus one distinct record excludes all three files and does not increment duplicate_count.

behavior_checks.name: mixed-and-empty-counts
behavior_checks.detail: Accepted opaque identifiers, three invalid categories, and an empty snapshot produce exact summaries with candidate conservation.

behavior_checks.name: single-snapshot-and-source-preservation
behavior_checks.detail: A record created after candidate discovery is not included; source file bytes remain unchanged.
